Could you provide us with a jsfiddle with your setup, based on one of these?

Is this for https://github.com/darrenfantasy/darrenfantasy.github.io ?

Hope we can help!
I think you're missing the import of font-awesome, you can link it like this: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/font-awesome/4.7.0/css/font-awesome.min.css">`
